a.lede: Robotaxi operator suspends driverless rides on high-speed roads nationwide after construction zone incursions and a run-in with patrol vehicles
a.title: California tells Waymo to take the next exit after freeway mishaps

b.title: Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why
